ENFORCE_QUEUE_ORDER.LABEL: Require picking up the queue in order
ENFORCE_QUEUE_ORDER.HELP: When enabled, this agent can't freely pick a conversation from the queue - only the next one (by priority, then oldest) via the "Pick up next in queue" button. Administrators are never affected by this.

LUNCH_BREAK.LABEL: Lunch break
LUNCH_BREAK.HELP: Auto assignment stops giving this agent new conversations 20 minutes before the start, and resumes normally at the end time. Conversations already assigned are not affected. Leave both fields empty to turn this off.
LUNCH_BREAK.ERROR: Fill in both times (start and end), with the end after the start
